note: The main banks: Bank of Palestine, Arab Bank and Quds Bank, the largest banks in Palestine. Arab Bank's Palestinian site (arabbank.ps) didn't answer (30 October 2026), and Quds Bank's home page names no credit card terms, so only Bank of Palestine's cards are written. Bank of Palestine's credit card page (read 30 October 2026): its Visa and Mastercard Classic (limits of $200 to $1,499) and Gold (from $1,500) cards, in US dollars, charge 2% a month on the used unpaid balance; each costs its issue commission again to renew when it expires, $25 every two years for the Classic, written as 12.50 a year, and $40 every three years for the Gold, written as 13.33 a year (rounded); the first issue commission isn't written, the renewal standing for it. Cash withdrawals at any ATM cost 4%, at least $4; purchases in stores and online, local or international, carry no commission (written as a 0% foreign transaction fee); the holder may repay 5% of the monthly balance, written as the minimum; the grace period is up to 45 days. Sub-card and replacement fees aren't written; the page states no late, over-limit or returned payment fee. This file kept the Classic card, read on 29 October 2026, and adds its terms and the Gold card.
